title: servicenow-preflight finding (v1)
description: One record-level finding behind a check's verdict.

message.description: One line; never echoes secrets or matched source text.

status.description: Verdict of this finding; defaults to the row's status.

CheckStatus.description: Outcome of a single preflight check.

FindingLocation.description: Where a finding lives: a record (table + sys_id + field, optionally a line in a script) or, for subjects that are not a single record, a logical id (`"scope/slug"`, `"instance"`, `"app:<scope>"`).

table.description: Table of the offending record, e.g. `"sys_script_include"`.

recordName.description: Display label of the record (`name`, falling back to the sys_id).

field.description: Field holding the offending value, e.g. `"script"`.

logicalId.description: Identity of a subject that is not one record.
